performance_intent: Simplifies the uint16_t decimal fast path and digit predicate, and changes the big-endian four-byte read
checked_scope: Public from_chars<uint16_t,char> in base ten, five arbitrary bytes, initial output 123, x86-64 little-endian LLVM IR
checker: Earlier Alive2 attempt on separate error, consumed-position, and value outputs; superseded by scoped_proof

result.error: new-to-old correct; old-to-new failed-to-prove because Alive2 approximated a large constant initializer
result.consumed_position: old-to-new and new-to-old correct on five arbitrary bytes
result.value: both directions failed-to-prove because Alive2 approximated a large constant initializer; auxiliary higher-constant-limit checker still timed out old-to-new at 120000 ms (zero incorrect transformations)
result.native_controls: Exact historical public APIs agree on all 100000 five-digit decimal strings, 16 named cases, and 200000 fixed-seed mixed strings of lengths 1 through 8

scoped_proof.scope: Exact historical public from_chars<uint16_t,char> on five arbitrary bytes, base ten, initial value 123, x86-64 Clang 20 -O2 LLVM IR; returned value, consumed position, and error code
scoped_proof.old_to_new: 1 correct, 0 incorrect, 0 failed to prove, 0 errors; no approximation
scoped_proof.new_to_old: 1 correct, 0 incorrect, 0 failed to prove, 0 errors; no approximation
scoped_proof.public_path_audit: check_public_path.py confirms unchanged historical public integer dispatch; old/new public-to-internal and internal-to-public Alive2 checks also pass

limitations: Only the specified five-byte public uint16_t,char base-ten call on x86-64 is proved. Other input lengths, code-unit types, bases, optional parsing macros, and big-endian builds remain unproved. No official historical before/after benchmark score was measured.
